_about: ACC-206 D1 MASTER fixture of the bill-total pick (web helpers.js billTotalOf). Row = a header summary_json + the detail column as the screens read them; expect = the hand-computed tax-in total (taxable + tax) the summary pick returns, or null; strip = what the chit-sheet spend strip shows when it differs (its detail-column last arm). Api slice C1 (tests/lib/bill-total-fixtures.cjs) must require THIS file, with a test that both name lists are equal. A credit note's stored total is positive: api tests/lib/truth-harness.cjs creditNote total = Number(ValDtls.TotInvVal).
